Cryptorchidism is a condition in which one or both the testicles are undescended in the scrotal sac. It is an Hereditary abnormality, meaning its passed on from one generation to the next generation.
The undescended testicle can be subcutaneous( Beneath the skin) or intra-abdominal( inside the Abdomen).
These Testicles have a very high chance of heading towards Sertoli cell tumours.
 Mating of such dogs should be discouraged and should be neutered wherein both the Testicles are removed.

Rubbish treatment, no idea of prevalent underlying condition - absolutely blinded us to a point - my dog finally died.

No, my dog was not having lose motions because her stomach was upset, no - she was not anxious because of sounds, no - she was not urinating frequently because of bladder issues, no- she wasn’t moaning because of arthritis pain. She was running a CKD which was left undiagnosed until one fine day - we went to another clinic only to realise it was too late.

She was anxious because of high Blood pressure, she was moaning because of kidney stones and she vomited because of ulcers again a result of kidney issue.

Even on the day she became critical - the doctor told my Father that it is not even a vomit.

What’s the hell just happened? I will never forgive what happened with my dog. My dog died and I had to Euthanise her. Even if K in kidney was spelled out, we could have done something. Atleast no suffering.

I want ppl to know my case. I want ppl to know what a trauma it has led to.

That’s it. I rest my case.

January in Numbers 🏥🐾
Every number tells a story of care, commitment, and compassion.
From emergency responses to successful treatments, January reflected the impact of dedicated veterinary care at Utkarsh Animal Hospital.
Because for us, metrics aren’t just numbers — they’re lives touched and lives saved.

जानेवारीचे आकडे 🏥🐾
प्रत्येक आकडा सांगतो सेवा, समर्पण आणि करुणेची गोष्ट.
आपत्कालीन मदत असो किंवा यशस्वी उपचार — जानेवारी महिना उत्कर्ष अ‍ॅनिमल हॉस्पिटलमधील विश्वासार्ह पशुवैद्यकीय सेवेचा ठसा उमटवणारा ठरला.
आमच्यासाठी आकडे म्हणजे फक्त संख्या नाहीत — ती वाचवलेली आयुष्ये आहेत.

Animals have rights too—and it is our responsibility to know and uphold them.
Animal welfare laws are designed to protect animals from cruelty, neglect, and abuse, ensuring they live with dignity and care. When we are informed about these laws, we become stronger voices for those who cannot speak for themselves.

Know a few important animal welfare rules in India:
• Causing cruelty, injury, or abandonment of animals is a punishable offence under the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960.
• Feeding or caring for community animals is legal and protected.
• Injured or sick animals must be given timely medical care.
• Animals have the right to food, water, shelter, and freedom from pain and fear.

Being aware is the first step towards action. Let’s stand together as responsible citizens and create a safer, more compassionate society for all living beings.

प्राण्यांनाही हक्क आहेत—आणि ते जाणून घेणे व त्यांचे संरक्षण करणे ही आपली जबाबदारी आहे.
प्राणी कल्याण कायदे प्राण्यांना क्रूरता, दुर्लक्ष आणि छळापासून वाचवण्यासाठी तयार करण्यात आले आहेत, जेणेकरून त्यांना सन्मानाने व सुरक्षिततेने जीवन जगता येईल.

भारतामधील काही महत्त्वाचे प्राणी कल्याण नियम:
• प्राण्यांवर क्रूरता करणे, त्यांना दुखापत करणे किंवा सोडून देणे हे प्राणी क्रूरता प्रतिबंधक कायदा, 1960 अंतर्गत गुन्हा आहे.
• रस्त्यावरील किंवा सामुदायिक प्राण्यांना अन्न देणे व काळजी घेणे कायदेशीर आहे.
• जखमी किंवा आजारी प्राण्यांना त्वरित वैद्यकीय उपचार देणे आवश्यक आहे.

Animal Birth Control isn’t just about animals—it’s about creating healthier communities and ensuring humane, long-term care.
ABC programs help control stray populations ethically, reduce conflicts, prevent the spread of diseases, and improve the quality of life for both animals and people.
Responsible, compassionate solutions begin with awareness and action.

प्राणी जन्मनियंत्रण (ABC) हे केवळ प्राण्यांपुरते मर्यादित नाही—ते निरोगी समाज आणि मानवी दृष्टिकोनातून काळजी घेण्याबाबत आहे.
ABC कार्यक्रमांमुळे भटक्या प्राण्यांची संख्या नैतिक पद्धतीने नियंत्रणात राहते, आजारांचा प्रसार कमी होतो, संघर्ष टाळले जातात आणि माणसे व प्राणी दोघांचेही जीवनमान सुधारते.
जबाबदार आणि करुणामय उपाययोजना जागरूकतेपासून आणि कृतीपासून सुरू होतात.

एनिमल बर्थ कंट्रोल (ABC) सिर्फ जानवरों के बारे में नहीं है—यह स्वस्थ समुदाय और मानवीय देखभाल सुनिश्चित करने का एक ज़रूरी कदम है।
ABC कार्यक्रम नैतिक तरीके से आवारा जानवरों की संख्या नियंत्रित करते हैं, बीमारियों के खतरे को कम करते हैं, टकराव रोकते हैं और इंसानों व जानवरों दोनों के जीवन स्तर को बेहतर बनाते हैं।
जिम्मेदार और संवेदनशील समाधान जागरूकता और सही कदमों से शुरू होते हैं।

True freedom lies in compassion—for people, animals, and our nation.
Celebrating a Republic that cares for all.

खरे स्वातंत्र्य करुणेत आहे—माणसांसाठी, प्राण्यांसाठी आणि आपल्या राष्ट्रासाठी.
सर्वांची काळजी घेणाऱ्या प्रजासत्ताकाचा आज गौरव साजरा करूया.

सच्ची आज़ादी करुणा में निहित है—लोगों के लिए, पशुओं के लिए और हमारे राष्ट्र के लिए।

I rescued a severely injured stray cat who was left to die on the road. One of his legs was badly damaged, and with genuine intention to save his life, I brought him here hoping he would receive proper treatment.

Instead of focusing on immediate care or suggesting alternate support options, I was asked to pay ₹5,000–₹6,000 upfront, while being told the total treatment could cost around ₹22,000. As someone who tried to help purely on humanitarian grounds, this was extremely discouraging.

I clearly explained my financial situation and honestly said that I could manage only ₹600–₹700 from my side, which was my genuine capacity. Unfortunately, there was no flexibility, no discussion about raising donations through their network, social media, or other sponsors — which I believe NGOs usually do.

If NGOs start asking large amounts from people who rescue and bring injured strays, then many good-hearted people will stop helping animals altogether. This defeats the very purpose of animal welfare.

With a heavy heart, I had no option but to leave the cat there, feeling helpless and guilty, knowing he might continue to suffer.

This experience was emotionally distressing and disappointing.

featured_reviews.name: Dr Rasika Biswas
featured_reviews.review_text:
My overall experience at PoshPets was satisfactory, with a few points worth highlighting for pet parents.

The store itself is well stocked — they offer a wide variety of pet foods, numerous treat options, and essentials such as pet wipes. Their toy selection is moderate but adequate. I was also informed that they provide several clinical services, including X-ray, 2D Echo, ultrasound, dental care, and have a veterinarian available on call. I did not use these services, but it is reassuring to know they are offered.

My visit this time was primarily for grooming my two Golden Retrievers. The grooming results were decent, and the overall job was acceptable. However, I did feel disappointed with the way the drying process was handled. They became anxious with the sound of the dryer, and I sensed the staff were a little rough or rushed, which made the dogs increasingly uncomfortable.

At one point, when I was trying to comfort them, a staff member asked me to wait outside — something I strongly disagreed with. As their pet parent, leaving them alone with strangers while they were visibly anxious was simply not an option for me. One of the dogs, who rarely barks, was barking continuously, which further indicated discomfort. Whether it was the air pressure of the blower or just the handling, they were not as calm as they usually are with me or at the other salon we frequent.

For comparison, I regularly visit another salon, which is smaller but far more gentle and consistent in their handling. I have never been asked to leave the room there, and my dogs have always been comfortable throughout the process.

Overall, PoshPets is a great place for pet supplies, and I would definitely return for shopping. However, for grooming, I would prefer to go elsewhere unless absolutely necessary, as I am particular about how my pets are handled — even the slightest roughness is not acceptable to me.
